Author: Ambuj Nath
Bench: Ambuj Nath
 In The High Court Of Jharkhand At Ranchi
 B.A. No. 1816 of 2025
 Sukra Oraon, aged about 45 years, son of late Chaita Oraon, resident of
 village- Jori, Cherga toli, P.O.- Jori, P.S. + District- Lohardaga.

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
... Petitioner
 - Versus -
 1. The State of Jharkhand
CORAM: - HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE AMBUJ NATH -----

For the Petitioner : Mr. Rajesh Kumar, Advocate  For the State : Mrs. Mohua Palit, A.P.P.
 ---
02/06.03.2025  Heard the parties.

The petitioner has been made accused in connection with Lohardaga Mahila P.S. Case No. 30 of 2023, for the offences registered under Sections 323/494/504/506/313/377/406/420/34 of the I.P.C. and charge sheet has been submitted under Sections 323/ 494/ 498A/ 504/ 506/ 313/
377/417/511 of the I.P.C., pending in the Court of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Lohardaga.
The petitioner happens to be the husband of the informant.
It was submitted that the present case has been instituted after 13 years of their marriage.
It was further submitted that informant has not sustained any injury at the hands of the petitioner.
Learned A.P.P. has opposed the prayer for bail.
Considering the fact that the present case has been instituted after 13 years of their marriage and informant has not sustained any injury, I am inclined to release the petitioner, on bail.

Accordingly, the petitioner, named above, is directed to be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 20,000/- (Rupees twenty thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each, to the satisfaction of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Lohardaga, in connection with Lohardaga Mahila P.S. Case No. 30 of 2023.

(Ambuj Nath, J.) Jay/-
